story.titleZh: 布里亚托雷发布会炮轰法官 阿尔派摩纳哥领奖台案前景成疑
story.summaryZh: 在国际汽联上诉法院撤销阿尔派车手加斯利的摩纳哥站领奖台资格后，车队执行顾问弗拉维奥·布里亚托雷在新闻发布会上矛头直指其中一名法官。
story.originalTitle: What's next after Briatore's press conference bombshell
story.summaryEn: After the FIA International Court of Appeal stripped Alpine's Pierre Gasly of his Monaco Grand Prix podium, executive advisor Flavio Briatore went on the offensive at a press conference, targeting one of the judges. He claimed the judge had links with McLaren and had acted like a prosecutor during the hearing.
detailZh: 周五，阿尔派 高级顾问 Flavio Briatore 掀起了近来最具爆炸性的 F1 新闻发布会之一，起因是 FIA 国际上诉法院的裁决剥夺了该车队的摩纳哥大奖赛领奖台。
就在 FIA 公布裁决——迈凯伦 和 红牛 针对恢复 加斯利 蒙特卡洛前三名成绩的上诉败诉——几个小时后，Briatore 发起了攻势。
但他并没有批评法官们得出的结论，而是特别把矛头指向其中一位法官，暗示他与 迈凯伦 有关联。
"Filippo Marchino 是一名法官，他在听证会上非常恶劣，表现得像个检察官，"Briatore 一边念着手中的稿纸一边说道。
"后来，我们发现了这个人为什么这么恶劣的原因。他和迈凯伦关系非常密切。"
Briatore说，他觉得这种情况"非常不公平"。
他还说："我们有这个人在2018年于Beverly Hills的MSO为迈凯伦演讲时的一张照片"，尽管他并没有出示那张纸。
"他有一个基金会，叫做One Drop Foundation，而迈凯伦送了两三辆迈凯伦汽车，"Briatore补充道。"这非常不公平。"
关于这些赛车的这一说法，具体与2019年为One Drop基金会举行的一场慈善拍卖会有关，Marchino是该基金会的董事会成员。
One Drop由太阳马戏团联合创始人Guy Laliberte创立，他长期以来与迈凯伦关系密切，是前迈凯伦掌门人Ron Dennis的朋友。
因此，该基金会从迈凯伦获得拍品，作为Briatore所提到的慈善拍卖的一部分，是有明确逻辑的。
Briatore的言论不仅令FIA和在场的媒体感到意外，显然也激怒了迈凯伦车队领队Andrea Stella，对于暗示其中存在任何不正当行为的说法，他作出了愤怒的回应。
斯特拉说："我发现这场会议朝这个方向发展，对迈凯伦来说相当侮辱，对一个值得高度尊重的车队的名誉来说也是如此。"
"如果有人提出这类指控——这些指控看起来相当严重——他们将必须为自己在公开场合所说的话承担责任。"
"听证会，整个国际上诉法院，都是以最高标准进行的，我们不应该像已经发生的那样质疑这一阶段。"
不过，布里亚托利暗示此事并未结束，他暗示阿尔派可能会考虑将此事进一步推进。
“我们一直在考虑这件事，”他说。“先过了这个周末，之后我们再考虑。目前，我还不知道。”
阿尔派（阿尔派）究竟有哪些可选方案并不清楚，因为国际汽联（FIA）国际上诉法院是最高权威机构——各方无法对其裁决提出上诉。
不过，存在一项与常规干事裁决类似的重审权利，即如果发现任何“在国际上诉法院案件开始时未知的重要新证据”，相关决定可以受到质疑。
布里亚托利暗示，阿尔派（阿尔派）在听证会结束之前对这些所谓联系一无所知。
"我们是在会议之后，按逻辑推论才得知的，而不是在会议之前，"他说。"我们查明这个人与迈凯伦车队有关联。"
目前尚不清楚布里亚托利所说的这一新信息是否足以达到申请复审的门槛，因为国际汽联上周五明确表示，评审团的组成要经过严格的审查程序。
国际上诉法庭拥有一份由36位顶尖法律专家组成的名单，每次案件会从其中至少选出八人组成一个候选池。
这个候选池会提前充分告知相关各方，以便各方判断是否存在"严重且客观的理由认为名单上的任何或全部法官因利益冲突或其他正当理由而应予回避"。
在这整个过程中，阿尔派 始终没有对入围法官的人选提出任何异议，这意味着 ICA 主席——摩纳哥的 Laurent Anselmi——得以继续推进并为听证会选定了四名法官。
有趣的是，根据 F1 规则，在与世界锦标赛相关的 ICA 听证会中，至少一名法官必须是应至少五支车队或三家制造商的提议，在 FIA 大会上被选入法官库的。
早在 2023 年，以及同样担任摩纳哥上诉听证会法官的就是由车队提名后，在 FIA 大会上获得任命的。
由车队提名的任何法官都要接受 FIA 合规官的尽职调查，随后由一个特别小组进行审查，之后才会向资格审查委员会提出建议。
除了这项初步评估之外，当评委被指派到具体案件时，他们必须向国际汽联（FIA）秘书长确认自己不受任何利益冲突的影响。
只有在这一步完成后，国际上诉法院（ICA）评审团的最终组成才会确定下来，并且对与案件有关的所有人保密，直到听证会当天才公布。
随着听证会结束和国际上诉法院裁决的出炉，F1围场还需要再等一等，看看围绕摩纳哥大奖赛领奖台长达三个月的争斗是否还会进一步延续。
detailEn: Alpine executive advisor Flavio Briatore stirred up one of the most explosive Formula 1 press conferences of recent times on Friday amid the fall out of the FIA International Court of Appeal verdict that took away his team's Monaco Grand Prix podium.

Just a few hours after the FIA published the verdict that McLaren and Red Bull's had been successful in their appeal against Pierre Gasly having his Monte Carlo top-three finish reinstated, Briatore went on the offensive.
But rather than criticise the conclusions the judges had come to, he took aim at one of them in particular in suggesting that he had links with McLaren.
"Filippo Marchino is a judge, he was very nasty during the hearing, was acting as a prosecutor," said Briatore as he read off a piece of paper in his hand.
"And after, we found out what is the reason why so nasty, this guy. He is very linked with McLaren."
Briatore said that he felt the situation was "very unfair".
He added "we have a nice picture of this guy at a speech for McLaren in 2018 in MSO, Beverly Hills", although without showing the piece of paper.
"He has a foundation, it's called One Drop Foundation, and McLaren gave two, three McLaren cars," Briatore added. "This was quite unfair."
This remark about the cars specifically is linked to a charity auction that was held in 2019 for the One Drop Foundation, of which Marchino sits on the board of directors.
One Drop was created by Guy Laliberte, the co-founder of Cirque du Soleil, who has long had ties to McLaren as a friend of former McLaren supremo Ron Dennis.
So, there is clear logic in it obtaining items from McLaren as part of the charity auction that Briatore referenced.

Briatore's remarks not only took the FIA and the media present by surprise, but they clearly infuriated McLaren team principal Andrea Stella, who gave an angry response to suggestions that there was anything untoward at play.
"I find that this conference going in this direction is quite insulting for McLaren, for the reputation of a team that deserves a lot of respect," said Stella.
"If anybody makes these kind of allegations - which seem quite serious - they are going to have to take the responsibility for what they are saying in a public forum.
"The hearing, the whole International Court of Appeal, was conducted to the highest standards and we should not question this phase like it’s been done."
Briatore suggested that the matter was not closed though, as he hinted that Alpine might considering taking the matter further.
"We’ve been thinking about it," he said. "Just pass the weekend and after that we think about it. For the moment, I don’t know."
Quite what Alpine's options could be is unclear, because the FIA's International Court of Appeal is the highest authority - and parties cannot appeal what it decides.

However, there is a right of review element that is similar to normal stewards' verdicts where decisions can be challenged if any "important new evidence is discovered which was unknown at the outset of the case before the ICA".
Briatore suggested Alpine knew nothing about the alleged links until after the hearing.
"We found out, after the meeting, logically, not before," he said. "We found out this guy was linked with the McLaren team."

It is unclear if what Briatore said is new information would be enough to cross the threshold for a right of review, because the FIA made clear on Friday that the make-up of the judging panel is put through a strong vetting process.
The International Court of Appeal has a roster of 36 leading legal experts, with at least eight of them selected to be part of a pool that can be picked for each case.

This pool is communicated to relevant parties well ahead of time to see if there are any "serious and objective reasons to consider that any or all of the shortlisted judges should be recused due to the existence of a conflict of interest or other legitimate grounds".

At no point in this process did Alpine offer any objection about who the shortlisted judges were, and that meant the president of the ICA - Monaco's Laurent Anselmi - went ahead and selected four for the hearing.

Interestingly, as part of F1's regulations, at least one of the judges involved in an ICA hearing that relates to the world championship must have been elected to the pool at the FIA's general assembly on proposal from at least five teams or three manufacturers.
Back in 2023, Marchino (as well as Luigi Fumagalli, who was also a judge in the Monaco appeal hearing) was nominated at the FIA's general assembly after being proposed by teams.

Any judges proposed by teams are subject to a due diligence check by the FIA compliance officer, and are then reviewed by an ad hoc panel before recommendations are made to the eligibility assessment committee.
Beyond this initial assessment, when judges are called up to specific cases they must confirm to the FIA's secretary general that they are not affected by any conflict of interest.
Only once this is complete will the final make-up of the ICA judging panel be finalised, with it then kept secret from everyone involved in the case until the day of the hearing.
With the hearing finished and the ICA verdict now out, the F1 paddock must wait a little longer to see if a three-month fight over the Monaco GP podium is prolonger further still.
keyPointsZh: 国际汽联公布裁决，迈凯伦与红牛的上诉成功，加斯利的摩纳哥前三名成绩被取消
布里亚托雷未批评判决结论本身，而是暗示法官菲利波·马尔基诺与迈凯伦有关联
布里亚托雷手持纸条宣读发言，称马尔基诺在听证会上表现恶劣、如同检察官
keyPointsEn: The FIA published the verdict confirming McLaren and Red Bull's appeal succeeded, removing Gasly's top-three Monaco finish.
Briatore did not criticise the conclusions but suggested judge Filippo Marchino had links with McLaren.
Reading from a piece of paper, Briatore said Marchino was nasty during the hearing and acted as a prosecutor.

detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔夺得杆位，梅赛德斯车队在卡塔尔大奖赛排位赛中占据领先，这是自5月份加拿大大奖赛以来的首次。

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
